
# ChronoConnections - Copilot Instructions

## Project
We are developing ChronoConnections, a bilingual historical gaming website for a school project.

## Strict technology requirements
- Use ONLY HTML5, CSS3 and vanilla JavaScript.
- Do NOT use React, Vue, Angular, Bootstrap, Tailwind, jQuery or other frameworks.
- Do NOT use Node.js, PHP, Python or backend technologies.
- The website must work as a static website hosted on GitHub Pages.
- Use JSON files for structured historical data where appropriate.
- Use LocalStorage for personal settings and saved scores.

## Four game modes
1. Historical Connections: Connect two historical figures through verified historical relationships.
2. Wikipedia Race: Navigate between two Wikipedia articles using internal links.
3. Mystery Figure: Identify historical figures using progressively revealed clues.
4. Historical Timeline: Arrange historical events chronologically.

## Language
- The entire website must support English and French.
- Include an EN/FR language switch.
- All interface elements, instructions, messages and results must be translated.
- Wikipedia Race should support both English and French Wikipedia.

## Design
- Combine modern gaming aesthetics with historical elements.
- Use a dark interface with elegant gold accents.
- Incorporate historical portraits, maps, parchment-inspired details and subtle animations.
- Make the website responsive for desktop, tablets and mobile devices.
- Prioritise readability and usability.

## Development rules
- Keep HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JSON organised in separate files.
- Write clean, readable and commented code.
- Avoid unnecessary complexity.
- Make sure all links and navigation work.
- Handle API errors and missing data properly.
- Never invent historical relationships, dates or sources.
- Provide sources for historical information.
- Do not generate the entire project in one response.

## How to work
- Work incrementally, one feature at a time.
- Before making major changes, explain what you intend to do.
- Do not overwrite existing working functionality unnecessarily.
- Explain important code decisions so the student can understand them.
- Test each feature before moving to the next.
- Ask before introducing additional technologies or dependencies.

## Current development priority
Begin with the website structure and homepage.
Do not implement the four game modes until the homepage and navigation are established.
